plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
domain: search.openvibe.network (vhost in deploy/nginx; the service manifest records the search page and query API as public since 2026-09-23)
deployment: Deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy search`: /opt/openvibe.search, unit openvibe-search, 127.0.0.1:4710, principal search, Events subscription *.index_document.*, accepted event owners (code defaults in server/config.js; SEARCH_EVENT_OWNERS in /etc/openvibe/search.env not checked) wiki, blog, news, reviews, deals, coupons, trade, community, live, media, codes, games, tools, sources, work, rent, help, inventory, quest, host. On 2026-10-10 the production index held, per the plan record, 1976 work jobs, 51 help articles and 70 inventory items (2097 documents) plus wiki tombstones; how many of them are public was not measured. Restore drill passed 2026-09-23.
features: saved searches with notifications through Network (needs SEARCH_SAVED_NOTIFY=1 and OV_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET; not yet verified in production)
Cloudflare purge queue (inert until CLOUDFLARE_PURGE_TOKEN is set)
openvibe-sdk/events outbox in service_outbox (legacy event_outbox retained for N-1 rollback)
